# Contract Service

## Purpose
The Contract Service is a core component of the billing system, responsible for managing agreements between the organization and its customers. It tracks contract terms, associated customers, and automatic payment methods, serving as the foundation for invoice generation and financial tracking.

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Contract** | `/plugins/Contract/getAllContracts` | POST | Lists all contracts. |
| **Contract** | `/plugins/Contract/createContract` | POST | Creates a new contract. |
| **ContractItem** | `/plugins/ContractItem/getAllContractItems` | POST | Lists items covered by contracts. |

## Dependencies
- **contract-model**: Core data structures.
- **billing-model**: Integration for charges.

## Interesting Features
- **Charge Referencing**: Contracts can refer to specific `ChargeReference` entities to manage billing context.
- **Itemized Agreements**: Supports complex contracts with multiple sub-items, each with its own lifecycle.

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as ContractController
    participant Service as ContractService

    User->>Controller: createContract(ContractCreate)
    Controller->>Service: validate(ContractCreate)
    Service->>Service: checkDates()
    Service-->>User: Contract Created
```
